basic_details.job_title: MGU Security Attendant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University, Kerala is appointing Security Attendants on a temporary daily wage basis at Rs. 755 per day, up to a maximum of Rs. 20,385 per month, for 90 days or until a regular appointment is made through the PSC, whichever is earlier. The notice lists 5 vacancies. Applications in the prescribed form must reach the university by 4 PM on 26 November 2026, in person, by email to [email protected], or by post.

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the prescribed form issued with the notification.
Attach self-attested copies of the certificates listed under Documents Named in the Notice below.
Submit the application to the Administration Section (AD A4 Section) in person, by email to [email protected], or by post.
For postal applications, write on the envelope that it is the application for selection to the post.
Make sure the application reaches the university by 4 PM on 26 November 2026.
Postal address: Assistant Registrar-1 (Administration Section), Administrative Block, Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarshini Hills P.O., Kottayam - 686560.
Self-attested copies of certificates proving age or date of birth, educational qualification and the other qualifications mentioned in the notification.
Self-attested copy of a recognised caste certificate or non-creamy layer certificate (if eligible for OBC reservation), or of the EWS income certificate (if applicable).

Self-attested copy of the experience certificate. Those who are serving or have served as temporary staff of Mahatma Gandhi University need not attach it and may state the period in the application instead.
Self-attested copy of the military or paramilitary service discharge certificate.
Self-attested copy of a medical fitness certificate issued after the date of the notification.

The form on page 2 of the notice asks for the name in Malayalam and in English capital letters, date of birth, religion and caste, forward or backward category, EWS status, permanent and present addresses, phone and mobile numbers, email ID, qualifications, educational qualification and employment experience, with place, date and signature. A section marked for office use is verified by the Assistant Section Officer and the Assistant Registrar.

content_sections.heading: About MGU
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University, Kerala is a university with its administrative office at Priyadarshini Hills P.O., Kottayam. This notice is issued by the university's Administration Section (AD A4 Section) under the signature of the Registrar (i/c). It is a government university recruitment, filled on a temporary daily wage basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice states the qualifications as follows. Ex-servicemen: the ability to read and write, plus military or paramilitary service experience (ex-servicemen, BSF, CRPF and similar forces). Women (10% representation): NCC B or C certificate holders, OR those who took part in the NCC Republic Day parade, OR those with service experience in the military, BSF or CRPF paramilitary forces. Age: upper age limit 30 years, counted as on 01.01.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. The notice does not name any formal educational degree. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay is Rs. 755 per day, with a maximum of Rs. 20,385 per month. The appointment is on a temporary daily wage basis, with 10% representation given to women. It runs for 90 days, or until a regular appointment is made through the PSC, whichever comes first.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU Security Attendant
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the prescribed form issued with the notification. Attach self-attested copies of the certificates listed under Documents Named in the Notice below. Submit the application to the Administration Section (AD A4 Section) in person, by email to [email protected] , or by post. For postal applications, write on the envelope that it is the application for selection to the post. Make sure the application reaches the university by 4 PM on 26 November 2026. Postal address: Assistant Registrar-1 (Administration Section), Administrative Block, Mahatma Gandhi University, Priyadarshini Hills P.O., Kottayam - 686560. Self-attested copies of certificates proving age or date of birth, educational qualification and the other qualifications mentioned in the notification. Self-attested copy of a recognised caste certificate or non-creamy layer certificate (if eligible for OBC reservation), or of the EWS income certificate (if applicable). Self-attested copy of the experience certificate. Those who are serving or have served as temporary staff of Mahatma Gandhi University need not attach it and may state the period in the application instead. Self-attested copy of the military or paramilitary service discharge certificate. Self-attested copy of a medical fitness certificate issued after the date of the notification. The form on page 2 of the notice asks for the name in Malayalam and in English capital letters, date of birth, religion and caste, forward or backward category, EWS status, permanent and present addresses, phone and mobile numbers, email ID, qualifications, educational qualification and employment experience, with place, date and signature. A section marked for office use is verified by the Assistant Section Officer and the Assistant Registrar.

faq.question: Q1. How many Security Attendant posts has MGU announced?
faq.answer: The notice lists 5 vacancies, to be filled on a temporary daily wage basis with 10% representation for women.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MGU Security Attendant?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the university by 4 PM on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for MGU Security Attendant?
faq.answer: Ex-servicemen need the ability to read and write plus military or paramilitary service experience. Women need an NCC B or C certificate, NCC Republic Day parade participation, or service experience in the military, BSF or CRPF.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years, counted as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for this post?
faq.answer: Pay is Rs. 755 per day, with a maximum of Rs. 20,385 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed form with self-attested certificate copies in person, by email to [email protected], or by post to the Assistant Registrar-1 (Administration Section) at the university in Kottayam.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is temporary on a daily wage basis, for 90 days or until a regular appointment is made through the PSC, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Is any post reserved for women?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointment gives 10% representation to women, who must hold an NCC B or C certificate, have taken part in the NCC Republic Day parade, or have military, BSF or CRPF service experience.

faq.question: Q9. Do former MGU temporary employees need an experience certificate?
faq.answer: No. Those serving or who have served as temporary staff of the university need not attach one and may state the period in the application instead.
